title: A Ometepe
goal: Buy a ferry ticket and understand the schedule
culture: A pasaje on a boat, a boleto on a bus. And the timetable has a condition attached to it that no printed schedule anywhere else has: si el lago deja — if the lake lets us. Cocibolca gets rough enough to cancel the crossing and everybody who works it talks about the lake as something that decides.

beats.en: What time does the ferry leave?
ok: a que hora sale el ferry
beats.good: The same question you asked at the bus terminal. Sale is what everything does here — buses, photographs, ferries.

beats.es: A las dos y media. Si el lago deja.
beats.good: A pasaje on a boat and a boleto on a bus. Nobody will correct you, and he will notice that you got it right.
De ida — one way. You are staying on the island a while, which is the correct decision and he will approve of it.

beats.es: Listo. A las dos y media, si el lago deja.
beats.objective: Ask what he means by that
beats.good: Cocibolca gets rough enough to cancel the crossing. Everybody who works this water talks about the lake as something that makes decisions.
